// CASE swift_honest expect=pass
func inOrder<T>(_ items: [T], _ step: (T) async throws -> Void, reason: String) async throws {
  for item in items {
    try await step(item)
  }
}
// CASE swift_distinct_plain expect=fire
func inOrder<T>(_ items: [T], _ step: (T) async throws -> Void, reason: String) async throws {
  for item in items {
    consume(try await step(item), try await save(item))
  }
}
// CASE swift_distinct_interp expect=fire
func inOrder<T>(_ items: [T], _ step: (T) async throws -> Void, reason: String) async throws {
  for item in items {
    consume(try await step(item), "\(try await save(item))")
  }
}
// CASE swift_distinct_multiline_interp expect=fire
func inOrder<T>(_ items: [T], _ step: (T) async throws -> Void, reason: String) async throws {
  for item in items {
    consume(
      try await step(item),
      """
      \(try await save(item))
      """)
  }
}
// CASE swift_distinct_raw_interp expect=fire
func inOrder<T>(_ items: [T], _ step: (T) async throws -> Void, reason: String) async throws {
  for item in items {
    consume(try await step(item), #"\#(try await save(item))"#)
  }
}
// CASE swift_distinct_try_optional expect=fire
func inOrder<T>(_ items: [T], _ step: (T) async throws -> Void, reason: String) async throws {
  for item in items {
    consume(try await step(item), try? await save(item))
  }
}
// CASE swift_distinct_member expect=fire
func inOrder<T>(_ items: [T], _ step: (T) async throws -> Void, reason: String) async throws {
  for item in items {
    consume(try await step(item), await store.value)
  }
}
// CASE swift_distinct_task_group expect=fire
func inOrder<T>(_ items: [T], _ step: (T) async throws -> Void, reason: String) async throws {
  for item in items {
    consume(try await step(item), await withTaskGroup(of: Void.self) { group in await audit(item) })
  }
}
// CASE swift_steps_distinct_interp expect=fire
func inOrderSteps(_ steps: [() async -> Void], reason: String) async {
  for step in steps { consume(await step(), "\(await audit())") }
}
